title: Puerto Rico Medicare Advantage - Elena PR vs Rosa USA - The Only Place in The Nation Where Better Outcomes Come With a Funding Penalty
description: Puerto Rico has the highest Medicare Advantage enrollment in the nation - 96.2% - and the highest quality ratings, yet its benchmark payment rate is roughly 41% below the national average. Through Elena in Puerto Rico and Rosa in Florida, this episode unpacks the $3,400-a-month federal support gap, the outdated formula behind it, and the USVI benchmark-floor fix CMS could adopt without an act of Congress.
